generator.selection: iteration modulo eight selects one valid state or one minimal distinguishing mutation; xorshift64 selects channels 1/6/11 and supported 8/14/20 dBm powers

cases.name: clock-domain-disabled
cases.minimal_distinguishing_mutation: omit MODEM_SYSCON Wi-Fi APB/MAC clock enable

cases.name: pll-strobe-missing
cases.minimal_distinguishing_mutation: enable the clock domain but omit RFPLL channel programming and strobe

cases.name: completed-invalid-channel
cases.minimal_distinguishing_mutation: replace a valid RFPLL channel code with 0x0123 while retaining the completed start strobe and full gain calibration

cases.name: corrupt-gain-tuple
cases.minimal_distinguishing_mutation: append one malformed three-word TX gain tuple after a valid calibration

cases.name: unsupported-power-step
cases.minimal_distinguishing_mutation: replace the valid quarter-dBm ceiling with 34, which is not a whole-dBm step

cases.name: unsupported-bandwidth
cases.minimal_distinguishing_mutation: replace HT20 RFPLL mode bits with an otherwise completed unsupported mode while retaining valid channel and calibration

cases.name: frontend-forced-off
cases.minimal_distinguishing_mutation: write force-off value 0x0200 after otherwise valid RF programming

discovery.previous_shadowed_path: rf-channel was unreachable because pll_locked previously meant both strobe completion and successful channel decode
discovery.model_correction: RFPLL strobe completion and channel validity are now independent state, so the ordered rf-channel diagnostic is causal
